title.en: Can ordinary code prove that a fragment came from one exact source version?
title.ru: Может ли обычный код доказать, что фрагмент взят из точной версии источника?

hypothesis.en: A byte-level source hash, byte range, fragment hash, and display excerpt can accept every intact anchor and reject every altered, missing, ambiguous, or unreadable anchor without an LLM.
hypothesis.ru: Hash источника, диапазон байтов, hash фрагмента и показываемая выдержка позволят принять все целые ссылки и отклонить все изменённые, потерянные, неоднозначные или нечитаемые ссылки без LLM.

implementation_contract: Look up the exact source_id + source_version.
Compare SHA-256 of the exact source bytes.
Require a valid half-open byte range [start, end).
Compare SHA-256 of the selected bytes.
Decode the selected bytes as UTF-8 and compare them with display_excerpt exactly.
If a legacy capsule has no byte range, accept no automatic guess; report not found or ambiguous.

frozen_cases.scenario: duplicate phrase with correct byte offsets
character offsets mistakenly sent as byte offsets
legacy quote occurs twice and has no offsets
look-alike Unicode character in display excerpt
line endings changed from LF to CRLF
correct fragment hash but wrong display excerpt
source exists but cannot be read

not_tested: whether the fragment supports a claim
whether the source itself is true or trustworthy
whether a remote private source actually exists
PDF, OCR, web-page, or database extraction
